name: Start, explosion and restart
description: A real collision shows the explosion before the result and allows a fresh round.
steps: Open the game and click STARTEN.
Let the character hit the first obstacle without jumping. Observe the impact and wait for GAME OVER.
expected: Score increases during play. Collision visibly breaks the character into glowing pieces before the result appears. Restart hides the result and starts a fresh score and zero coins.

name: Nine character themes
description: Each character selection starts a run with its own visuals and obstacle.
steps: For each choice Blau, Rot, Blitz, Feuer, Ninja, Saiyajin, Overlord, Kämpfer and Heli, select the character, start a round and observe the first obstacle. After a collision choose the next character.
expected: All nine choices work. Obstacles match: Blau neon block, Rot crystal, Blitz electricity pillar, Feuer water, Ninja samurai, Saiyajin energy barrier, Overlord pillar, Kämpfer spearman, Heli ground turret.

name: Mobile jump limit and colored effects
description: Touch controls keep the square character in view and enforce the air jump limit.
steps: Tap the playfield four times rapidly while airborne, then tap a fifth time.
Let the character land or restart after collision, then jump again.
expected: The square fighter jumps on touch, displays silver white jump particles and visible fire dagger sparks. A fifth airborne tap adds no extra jump. Landing resets the jump allowance. Controls fit the mobile screen.

name: Coins, fire dagger bonus and magnet
description: Collectibles give visible feedback and temporary bonuses during a normal run.
steps: Select Kämpfer, start and use repeated jumps to survive and collect gold coins. Retry after a loss if needed.
Collect the rotating weapon pickup by jumping into it. Touch an obstacle while the weapon is active.
Continue until the weapon expires. Collect a magnet and observe nearby coins moving toward the fighter, then the attraction stopping when the effect expires.
expected: Collected coins increase the coin counter and score. The fighter carries a flaming dagger separated from the body with a small sheath. The weapon bonus shows two orbiting fire daggers and destroys obstacles for bonus points while active. Its expiration removes the orbiting weapons. The magnet temporarily attracts nearby coins.

name: Samurai warning and sword attack
description: A nearby samurai visibly warns and attacks; the player can jump over its blade.
steps: Select Ninja and start. Let the first samurai approach without jumping. Observe its warning, sword swing and short lunge, followed by the collision explosion.
Restart and use Space or ArrowUp to jump over the approaching samurai.
expected: The samurai raises a warning before swinging and lunging nearby. A hit causes the visible explosion and delayed result. A jump above the enemy and sword avoids that attack.

name: Graphics levels and mobile power safeguards
description: Graphics settings work during play without causing an extra jump or changing the game pace.
steps: Open the game on a phone and check the graphics selector shows Maximal.
Start a round. Switch to Schwach and then Normal while staying in the game.
Choose Maximal again and reload the page.
expected: All three choices are available and visible. Schwach reduces effects and draw workload, Normal restores a clearer image, Maximal restores richer visuals within a bounded mobile resolution. Changing the selector does not trigger a jump. The selected setting persists after reload.
